title: [#278/#281] Carry MidiMsg through the MIDI pipeline and strip javax.sound.midi from tuner
body:
Resolves #281

Sub-issue 3 of the #278 stack, implementing decisions D5, D6 and D7 of the [design](https://github.com/calinburloiu/microtonalist/blob/refactoring/isolate-java-midi/issues/00278-isolate-java-midi/2026-09-07-isolate-java-midi-design.md).

- `MidiSplitter` becomes a receiver over any `MidiTransmitter`; `MidiProcessor` is typed on `MidiMsg` and its output is a `MidiProcessorTransmitter` running the connect/disconnect protocol inside the write lock.
- `MidiSerialProcessor` wires neighbours through `receivers` / `clearReceivers()`; `MultiTransmitter` is deleted.
- Conversion happens once, at the device boundary in `MidiDeviceHandle`.
- `tuner` (`Tuner`, `TuningChanger`, the processors, all tuners, `Track`, `TrackManager`) works on `MidiMsg` and no longer imports `javax.sound.midi`.
- `SysExMidiMsg.StatusByte` / `EndOfExclusiveByte` replace the Java constants in `MtsMessageGenerator`.

**Stacked PR** — based on `refactoring/280-midi-transmitter-family` (#287), not on `main`. Review after the PRs below it in the stack.
